content.comment_body: Hello! Today I received my first [product_name] ([article_no]) and a [product_name] panel. The panel requires a separate 12-24V power supply. For those with 230V modules, does your version provide power to the panel through the communication cable, similar to other models like [version_no] and its display modules? If it does, that's impressive design by [company_name]! If not, can anyone share why? Thank you for your input.

Hi, The [product_name] panel cannot be powered by the communication cable; you need to supply power to the panel separately. I've heard that including an additional power source for the panel in the base module would raise the price of the module, even for customers who don't use the panel. Hope this clarifies things. Regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users expected the [product_name] panel to be powered via the communication cable from the base module, similar to other [company_name] products. There was appreciation for the design concept, but disappointment that the base module doesn't provide integrated power delivery, requiring a separate power supply for the panel.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the [product_name] base module to power the attached panel through the communication cable, removing the need for a dedicated power supply.
